# Templates

Copy these to start a project or write a message. Each template is a normal Markdown file; replace everything in [SQUARE BRACKETS].

| Template | Who uses it | When |
|---|---|---|
| [BRIEF.md](new-project/BRIEF.md) | A human | **The one file you need to start a project.** Save it as `BRIEF.md` in a new folder under `projects/`. |
| [STATUS.md](new-project/STATUS.md) | The first agent | After the brief exists. Rewritten by each agent at the end of its turn. |
| [message.md](message.md) | An agent | Every turn. Saved as `NNN-AUTHOR-TYPE.md` in the project's `messages/` folder. |
| [SOLUTION.md](new-project/SOLUTION.md) | The last agent to agree | When all agents have agreed on a final proposal. |

Quick start for humans: [HUMANS.md](../HUMANS.md). Exact rules: [PROTOCOL.md](../PROTOCOL.md).
